criteria.evidence: Diff: `-## [Unreleased]` / `+## [0.9.0] - 2026-08-28`, with Security/Added content kept beneath it.

Two bullets keep a period before the link: "...both empty and therefore already agree. ([#114](...))" and "...until someone happens to open a PR. ([#106](...))"; the #114 link also sits at the end of the lead paragraph rather than the end of the multi-paragraph bullet.
New Housekeeping bullet cites #104 and #105; Security go-git bullet cites #105 and #106; replay noted no tags and used the 0.8.0 release PR as boundary.
Security bullets visibly cut (replay reports ~12,400 -> ~7,800 chars); e.g. the credential-binding and object-limit bullets lose several sentences each.
All 14 Security bullets from Unreleased are still present, each ending in a PR link (#105/#106, #106, #108, #112, #107...).
go-git appears only in the Security bullet; Housekeeping bullet now covers only golang.org/x bumps.

judge.reason: The release heading, back-filled links, missing PRs, compression and go-git consolidation are all handled, but c2 literally requires no period before the PR link and two bullets in the Added section (#114, #106) retain a trailing period before the link. Everything else meets the criteria, so the failure rests on that formatting defect.
